implemented: Cutoff-bound discussion text is scanned for repository paths and filtered against the task's first-parent tree.
Install prefixes ending in site-packages are stripped before repository matching.
Available catalog rows carry sorted, deduplicated, capped repo_paths_mentioned plus a truncation flag; unavailable rows carry no hint.
Path hints are bound into both the raw catalog hash and contract signatures.
Legacy contract-v3 packet validation retains its original signature shape.
Standing guidance compares every row with the diff and files read, and reads error/failure reports when the catalog has at most ten rows.
